title: Glow Test With Wren’s Stick

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Wren, can your stick tell how bright our glow is?

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: It measures each friend’s help, watch the light grow!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: I’ll stand still and listen to the meadow’s whisper.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Now Marlow brings snacks, see if the glow giggles!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: The light twinkles brighter, listening really works!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Let’s share this bright secret with all friends!
